title: Evidence object (evidence/0)
description: Proves what a record said, under which schema version, who wrote it, when, and what it replaced. The domain model stays in the system of record; this object points at it. Rules the schema cannot express (canonical id, calendar-valid timestamps, number range, duplicate members) are in spec/evidence-0.md.

id.description: sha256 of the RFC 8785 canonical form of this object without id.

op.description: create/update/delete: a change to a record. assert: a statement about a subject (a decision, a check result) that is not itself a record change.

ref.description: The system of record's own name and version for the definition, e.g. rec-registry/installation@12.

hash.description: sha256 of the definition document's bytes as published (DDL, JSON Schema, data dictionary).

system.description: The system of record, e.g. rec-registry.

type.description: The record type in that system, e.g. installation.

key.description: The record's key in that system.

hash.description: For application/json: sha256 of the record's canonical form. Otherwise: sha256 of the bytes.

uri.description: Where the bytes can be fetched. Optional.

inline.description: The record itself, for small JSON records. Must hash to content.hash.

on_behalf_of.description: Required for agents: the person or body accountable for the agent's output.

prev.description: Ids of the versions this object replaces. Empty for a first version. A list, so histories can merge.

ext.description: Profile data keyed by profile id (e.g. centr/0). Covered by the id. Profiles define their own rules.

timestamp.description: UTC only. Must also be a real calendar instant (checked outside the schema).
